nodes.name: Does it look like an enquiry?

parameters.content:
## Website enquiry -> one email

A visitor sends the enquiry form on /contact-us/ (or the chat on any other
page). The site POSTs the five fields here, this workflow checks them and
emails the office. Nothing is booked, held or promised.

**Before it runs:** put the recipient in **Settings**, add a Gmail OAuth2
credential to **Email the enquiry**, activate, then copy the production webhook
URL from **Enquiry received** into the site's `N8N_ENQUIRY_WEBHOOK_URL`.

The reply-to on the email is the enquirer, so hitting Reply answers them.
